slides.text: I’m Og‘abek Avazov. I build web systems for universities, AI services and businesses, from the interface to the server.
RAG, voice assistants and agents: I have shipped AI into real products such as Yurist AI and JARVIS.
Production deploys on Docker, Nginx and AWS, with tests and monitoring, so the system keeps running after launch.

heading: IN SHORT
ABOUT ME
intro.statement: I build systems that real people use every day: university portals, AI assistants and websites, from the technical spec to a running version on the server.

PROJECTS
projects.intro: University platforms, AI products and websites. On each one I went from the idea to the deploy myself.

heading: OG‘ABEK
AVAZOV
bio: I’m a full-stack developer. I take a product the whole way from the idea to a running version on the server: the spec, the interface, the backend, the database and the deploy.

Much of my work is for Tashkent State University of Law: a platform for researchers, open courses, the endowment fund and an internship system. Alongside that I run the Law Lab IT studio and build my own AI products.

principles.title: Spec first, then code
principles.text: Every project starts with a written spec, roles and acceptance criteria.

principles.title: Tests are part of the job
principles.text: Playwright, Jest and load tests: key flows are checked before every deploy.

principles.title: Secure by default
principles.text: Roles, audit trails, rate limits, file checks and secrets kept out of the repository.

principles.title: Done means deployed
principles.text: Production on Docker, Nginx and SSL. The work is not finished until the running system is checked.
